How this page works

Paste your script or treatment. Select text for a toolbar to pick a shot size, underline, highlight, or add a note — or right-click to create a shot. Or arm a tool below (or press U for underline, 1–4 for a highlight colour, N for a note) and just select text to apply it. Underlines, highlights and notes stay on the page and never appear in the shotlist.

Walls, openings and shapes belong to the location and are shared by every scene there. Cameras and props belong to the selected scene. Everything is undoable.

Edit the script directly?

Typing changes how the text flows, so the page breaks — and the number of pages — can move. Shot references and highlights stay attached to their text, but deleting text a shot was made from will ask what to do with that shot.

Choose Save changes when you're done to re-flow the pages.

Replace the current script?

Importing this PDF will replace everything in the Script tab. This can be undone with Ctrl/Cmd+Z afterward.

Compare with an updated version

Paste a revised draft below (or import a PDF) to see exactly what changed before anything in the Script tab is touched.

Preferences

Pick a list, then click an option to hide it from the dropdowns. Hidden options stay on any shot that already uses them. Saved in this browser.
